thread:
Sylvie: Quick follow-up from yesterday's DR postmortem. We keep seeing three repeating failure modes during rehearsals: route publish races, cross-region snapshot skew, and premature healthcheck-triggered cross-region promotions. Need owners, short timelines, and a clean tracking cadence.
Diego: I'll pick up route publish races. Hypothesis: concurrent publisher + reconciler writes cause transient mismatches. Plan: add a write-token and make reconcile idempotent + backoff. Target: 6 business days for a staging patch + canary.
Lila: I'll take runbooks + game-day ops. I'll add a pre-flight checklist and a two-step approval for any automated regional promotion. Can we do the dry-run on Sat 04/11 03:30 PT to minimize surface area?
Jamal: I'll own snapshot/skew and quick-restore smoke-tests. Proposal: nightly schema-only restore to a tiny instance, capture restore-time metric, and escalate if lag > 10m twice in 24h. ETA: 3 working days for pipeline + dashboard.
Priya: I'll handle customer comms & support coordination. I'll also request product mute for customer-facing alerts during the window.
ops-bot: Created task 9123 "route-write-token-and-reconcile" -> @Diego, due 6d. Created task 9124 "nightly-schema-restore" -> @Jamal, due 3d. Created recurring task 9125 "weekly-failover-patterns-audit" -> oncall-rotation, first run 04/06.
Diego: Draft checklist for routing change: 1) generate write-token 2) publish route 3) run reconcile 4) verify route-diff metric == 0 after 90s 5) canary at 0.5% with circuit-break to origin on >2% error for 3m. Posting PR soon.
Jamal: Smoke-test sketch: ```bash
# fetch latest snapshot id
SNAP=$(aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters "Name=tag:env,Values=prod" --query 'Snapshots[-1].SnapshotId' --output text)
aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SNAP
# attach to tiny instance, run app-health checks, emit restore_time metric
```
Lila: Runbook preflight additions: 1) confirm KMS cross-region keys 2) ensure peering routes are intact 3) reserve minimal infra 4) support rotation present 5) mute metrics/alerts for customer-facing channels. Will push docs and mock playbook.
Priya: I'll coordinate mute with product and support. Also will draft the post-run customer note template for transparency + rollback assurances.
Diego: One more thing 1% of traffic canary seems safe, but we'll keep manual approval gate for >5% rollouts. Asking infra for a small manual rollback endpoint.
ops-bot: Noted. Task 9126 created: "manual-rollback-endpoint" assigned to infra-rotation.
Jamal: For alerts: if replication lag >8m twice in 24h, escalate to infra pager. I'll add a dashboard with 95/99p lag and a restore_time timeseries.
Sylvie: Ownership recap: Diego -> routing write-token & reconcile (6d), Jamal -> nightly schema restores + dashboard (3d), Lila -> runbook + dry-run (scheduled Sat 04/11 03:30 PT), Priya -> comms & alert mute. Ops-bot -> recurring weekly audit.
Lila: I'll add a 30m retro slot right after the dry-run and collect friction notes.
Diego: I'll open PR ff/route-reconcile-2026 and include unit + integration tests. Tagging @Jamal for smoke-test hooks.
Jamal: Confirmed. Starting pipeline tomorrow and will post first run results to #incidents.
Priya: Confirmed. Drafting customer note and will share for review.
Sylvie: Please confirm owners/timelines by EOD. I'll update the postmortem and mark P0/P1. If no objections, I'll publish the action-tracker at 18:00 PT.
Diego: Confirmed.
Jamal: Confirmed.
Lila: Confirmed.
Priya: Confirmed.
Sylvie: Thanks all  I'll publish update at 18:00 PT and ping owners daily until closure.
